description: invisit is a hosted, cookieless web analytics product that tracks website visits, sources, AI referrals, funnels, revenue, errors, heatmaps, and web vitals. It provides a dashboard plus programmatic access for apps and AI assistants to read analytics and manage site-related settings.
summary: invisit exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a REST API at `api.invisit.dev/v1` authenticated with site API keys, and a remote MCP server at `app.invisit.dev/mcp` authenticated primarily with OAuth and optionally with MCP personal tokens for non-OAuth clients.
